description: Grade information itself contains revealing attributes about students' academic performance that can support identification and create privacy concerns when shared across multiple stakeholder views.
assumptions: Grade data includes performance metrics that reveal student capabilities

title: Sensitive educational data processing
description: Grade records constitute sensitive educational data that should only be processed when strictly required. The service processes this data to build views for multiple stakeholder groups.
assumptions: Grades are considered sensitive personal data under educational privacy regulations

title: Data shared with predetermined parties
description: Grade data is made accessible to a predetermined set of parties (students, parents, teachers) which may exceed what is functionally necessary for each individual view type.
assumptions: All three stakeholder groups receive access to grade data through this service

title: Student unawareness of grade data processing
description: Students may not be fully aware of how their grade data is being processed, combined, and shared across different views for parents and teachers through the grading service.
assumptions: Students may not have visibility into the data processing activities

title: Lack of student control over grade data preferences
description: Students may lack control to set preferences or consent regarding how their grade data is processed and which views (student, parent, teacher) receive access to their information.
assumptions: System may not provide granular consent mechanisms for different stakeholder views

title: Potential violation of data minimization principle
description: The service may process more grade data than actually needed for each specific view type, potentially violating data minimization requirements under GDPR and educational privacy regulations.
assumptions: Service may not implement view-specific data filtering
uncertainty_note: Depends on implementation details of view generation
